learnordie.guide.keys.title: The teacher's keys
learnordie.guide.keys.text: %s: the settings. %s: the dictionary of what you learned. %s: he names the block or mob you look at, muted or not. %s: how fast he talks. %s: his voice off and on. %s: the teacher away or back. %s: this guide.
learnordie.guide.questions.title: When he asks you
learnordie.guide.questions.text: Every so often the teacher stops you with a question about something he said: pick the German out of four, or type it in. Now and then an exam asks about what came up most. How often and how he asks are in the settings (%s).
learnordie.guide.consequences.title: Right or wrong
learnordie.guide.consequences.text: A right answer may earn you a small reward. A wrong one costs something: bad effects, hostile mobs, lost hearts or worse, whatever the settings (%s) say. Rewards and penalties work in single player only.
learnordie.guide.angry.title: Mind his temper
learnordie.guide.angry.text.drop: Get %s wrong one after another and he loses his temper: everything you carry falls to the ground. The settings (%s) can change that.
learnordie.guide.angry.text.delete: Get %s wrong one after another and he loses his temper: everything you carry is gone for good. The settings (%s) can change that.
learnordie.guide.angry.text.off: His temper is switched off: he frowns at a wrong answer, and %s wrong one after another do nothing more. The settings (%s) can switch it on.
learnordie.guide.reopen: %s shows the guide again; %s opens the settings.
learnordie.tip.open: A few settings worth a look (%s):
learnordie.tip.same_again: Repeat a phrase after: how soon he may say the same phrase again
learnordie.tip.question_every: Ask every: the time between his questions
learnordie.tip.penalty: Wrong answers: what a mistake costs you
learnordie.tip.quiz: Questions: buttons, typed, both or none
